prices_note: RouteWatch does not compare shop prices itself. FSAddonCompare already does that for 9000+ add-ons across Aerosoft, Contrail, Flightsim.to, iniBuilds, Just Flight, Orbx, simMarket and the Marketplace, with price history and sale alerts. Direct search links per candidate are below. If you do want prices in this dashboard, set settings.price_scrape to true and fill price_urls per candidate with direct product URLs; the app then reads the schema.org JSON-LD price field. Off by default: scraping is fragile and shops set their own terms.
